maddeler.e:
تستلموا (form VIII)
# تَسْتَلِمُوا (tastalimū) /tas.ta.li.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَلَمَ (istalama)
# تُسْتَلَمُوا (tustalamū) /tus.ta.la.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَلَمَ (istalama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
